An eccentric individual was the "'''admiral'''" of the [[Junk Armada]]&mdash;a collection of decommissioned [[Starship/Legends|ships]] that was yoked together by [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic fields]] and traveled through [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="Junk Armada" />&mdash;by [[3643 BBY]]. Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "The Junk Armada" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> the Junk Armada passed through a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] at the same [[Time/Legends|time]] an individual affiliated with one of the factions in the then-ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] was there.<ref name="Junk Armada" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
The individual sent a companion to search the Junk Armada for any useful items. The "[[Admiral/Legends|admiral]]" became fond of the companion and allowed them to search those vessels that remained more intact. The companion subsequently returned from the Junk Armada with a large haul of scrap materials.<ref name="Junk Armada" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Junk Armada's "admiral" was mentioned as part of the Crew Skill mission "The Junk Armada" of the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The information about the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Junk Armada" />
